    {
      "name": "unsafe_enable_version_guessing",
      "input_type": "BOOLEAN",

      "default_value": "false"

      "scope": "GLOBAL",
      "evidence": "| `iceberg_use_metadata_log` | `BOOLEAN` | `true` | Use a table's optional `metadata-log` to preserve atomicity guarantees, at the cost of an additional metadata `GET` in rare cases.",
      "default_kind": "literal",
      "default_value": "true",
      "default_evidence": "`true`"
    },
    {
      "name": "ignore_target_file_size_for_partitioned_tables",
      "input_type": "BOOLEAN",
      "scope": "GLOBAL",
      "evidence": "| `ignore_target_file_size_for_partitioned_tables` | `BOOLEAN` | `false` | Ignore the unsupported `write.target-file-size-bytes` table property on partitioned tables instead of raising an error.",
      "default_kind": "literal",
      "default_value": "false",
      "default_evidence": "`false`"
    },
    {
      "name": "ignore_row_group_size_for_partitioned_tables",
      "input_type": "BOOLEAN",
      "scope": "GLOBAL",
      "evidence": "| `ignore_row_group_size_for_partitioned_tables` | `BOOLEAN` | `false` | Ignore the unsupported `write.parquet.row-group-size-bytes` table property on partitioned tables instead of raising an error.",
      "default_kind": "literal",
      "default_value": "false",
      "default_evidence": "`false`"
    },
    {
      "name": "iceberg_via_aws_sdk_for_catalog_interactions",
      "input_type": "BOOLEAN",
      "scope": "GLOBAL",
      "evidence": "| `iceberg_via_aws_sdk_for_catalog_interactions` | `BOOLEAN` | `false` | Use the legacy AWS SDK code path to interact with AWS-based catalogs instead of DuckDB's HTTP client.",
      "default_kind": "literal",
      "default_value": "false",
      "default_evidence": "`false`"
    }
  ]
}
